hypotheses.R0_forward_backward_duality_is_exact: The cap-weighted RMSNorm JVP score matches the residual-adjoint projection to relative error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.R1_uniform_and_natural_raw_roles_agree: Uniform-vocabulary weight labels and natural-frequency raw-unembedding labels agree on at least 8 of 16 axes for target or top1.
hypotheses.R2_raw_and_exact_natural_roles_agree: Natural-frequency raw-unembedding and exact-adjoint labels agree on at least 8 of 16 axes for both target and top1.
hypotheses.R3_rms_and_exact_natural_roles_agree: RMS-aware and exact-adjoint labels agree on at least 12 of 16 axes for both target and top1.
hypotheses.R4_rms_metric_predicts_exact_scores: Median per-axis RMS-aware versus exact score correlation is at least 0.98 on every corpus for target and top1.
hypotheses.R5_raw_unembedding_is_numerically_adequa: Median per-axis raw-unembedding versus exact score correlation is at least 0.80 on every corpus for target and top1.
hypotheses.R6_output_metric_effect_transfers: The RMS-aware correlation advantage over raw unembedding is nonnegative on every corpus and endpoint.
hypotheses.R7_three_role_definitions_are_reported_s: Uniform vocabulary, natural-frequency raw, and context-metric roles are retained as distinct interpretation targets rather than silently merged.
